_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading midstream service provider and own one of the nation’s premier NGL systems, connecting NGL supply in the Rocky Mountain, Permian and Mid-Continent regions with key market centers and own an extensive network of natural gas gathering, processing, storage and transportation assets.' 'Each of our three segments are primarily fee-based, and our consolidated earnings were approximately 90% fee-based in 2021.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely our earnings and cash flows.' (the FY2021 10-K's own words; it does not use the word cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty; ENERGY_TRANSITION's reserves and refining are out of scope (the TRGP and BKR reading): ONEOK holds no reserves of its own and refines nothing ('We may not be able to accurately estimate hydrocarbon reserves and production volumes expected to be delivered to us for a variety of reasons, including the unavailability of sufficiently detailed information and unanticipated changes in producers’ expected drilling schedules.'); its greenhouse gas risk factor: 'We may face significant costs to comply with the regulation of GHG emissions.' (text only); its climate risk factor: 'Increasing attention to ESG matters, including climate change, may impact our business.' (text only); EV and CRYPTO are out of scope: the 10-K names neither electric vehicles nor crypto (text only)

BEAR.desc: EPS -53.7%/yr (worst year FY12-FY21, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +102.9%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +102.9%/yr (FY12-FY21 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +102.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY21, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2022-04-01) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.11x (81.8% downside to Bear $13 / +737.2% upside to Bull $598) | Adj composite 2.20 vs market 1.00: gap +1.20 [UNDERVALUED] | +12% above the EPP floor $64 (17x FY22E $3.76) | Conservative 2-yr case: +505.5% total (+252.8%/yr) | At 19.0x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $94 sits at or below the BASE case; net margin +16.7% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q4 2021, forward revenues +110.9% (no FY22 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2021 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to reserves and refining, EV to fuel retail, CRYPTO to payments and banks).
